tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Free appointment start times of one professional, in the professional's own time zone (start_local) and as ISO 8601 with offset (start). Give either one date (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 90 days ahead) or a number of days from today (1-14, default 7). Only professionals with can_book = true have bookable time

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Hold one free time for the user for 5 minutes. This does NOT book the appointment. It returns confirm_url: you MUST show that link to the user right away and tell them to open it, enter their phone number and the code we text them, and confirm. Until they do, nothing is booked; never say the appoint
